title: Partition Labels

examples.explanation: The parts are `"ababcbaca"`, `"defegde"`, and `"hijhklij"`. Each letter appears in only one of them.

constraints: The string has between 1 and 500 lowercase letters.
Parts must be contiguous and cover the whole string.
Once a letter appears in a part, it may not appear in any other part.
More parts are better, as long as the rule holds.
